title: Fourier representations of fractional B Splines via generalized Stirling type polynomials
summary: In this paper, we investigate fractional B splines and their connections with Fourier analysis, and establish connections with generalized Stirling-type numbers and distribution theory. Employing a generating function approach inspired by recent results of Simsek [24], we derive a novel Fourier type expansion for fractional B splines that involves generalized Stirling type numbers. Our main contribution is the derivation of a Fourier-type expansion of fractional B splines in terms of generalized Stirling-type numbers.
